answers.core: As the vector types are built-in this can only be dealed with by the core.
answers.workaround:
I think it will be used very often as we are talking about 2D- and 3D-space coordinates.
There exists a solution already by using the longer format Vector2(x,y) resp. Vector3(x,y,z).
It's just more noisy and less readable imo especially for default array initializations.

title: Add an alternative vector type notation - `(x, y)` for `Vector2(x, y)` and `(x, y, z)` for `Vector3(x, y, z)`
